## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and cover the change (unit, property, fixture, or browser as appropriate).
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (format, lint, types, unit tests with the 99% coverage gate).
- [ ] Documentation updated for any public behaviour change (README, CHANGELOG).
- [ ] No unrelated formatting or refactoring.

### If this changes emitted words

- [ ] A fixture or probe proves the new behaviour (`test/fixtures/`), and its origin is stated.
- [ ] `docs/ASPSX-2.81.md` describes the rule, and any `VERIFY-n` item it settles is closed there and in the README.
- [ ] The CHANGELOG entry is under **Fidelity**, not under API changes.
